findings.issue: Spec FR-3 states grant scope nodeLevel:'org', which is not a valid NodeLevel value (grant-lattice.ts NodeLevel union = application|registry|record|department|position). The migration correctly uses nodeLevel:'department' consistent with spec §6's migration contract and ADR §5. This is a spec doc typo — the code follows the correct value from the authoritative §6 contract. The role-assignment-scope DB fitness test passes, confirming all seeded org_scope values are valid lattice elements.
findings.suggestion: Fix the typo in spec FR-3 to match §6: nodeLevel:'department' instead of nodeLevel:'org'. No code change required.

The pattern is accepted convention for this codebase, not a test integrity hole. Noted for completeness.
